title: Unbounded string copy with stpcpy (c)
description: The code copies with stpcpy, which writes until the source terminator and returns a pointer to the end. There is no destination size, so a source longer than the buffer overwrites whatever follows it.
remediation: Copy with an explicit bound, for example snprintf with the destination size, and check that the result fits before writing.
limitation: Lexical, line-based: matches the copy without tracking the destination size.
